source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division (Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946)

note: Triennial election of Down County Council on the 20 single-member county electoral divisions. Polling took place on Thursday 3 October 1946 in the two contested divisions, Hillsborough and Warrenpoint; the other eighteen were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 20 September and 4-5 October 1946). Returned unopposed.
